title: match.outcome.v1
description: Phase 5+ — terminal-state outcome stream emitted by the storage agent when a match_detail record reaches a terminal status. Phase 6 drift agent consumes this to compute rolling Brier per predictor; Phase 6 proofreader uses it to ground-truth live verdicts. Producer is the storage agent only; predictor / consensus agents must NOT publish here (boundary discipline mirrors freshness.events.v1).

settled_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when storage observed the terminal state.

record_id.description: Storage row id of the match_detail record carrying the terminal payload.
